examples.text: Lo que no te mata te fortalece.
examples.en: What doesn't kill you will make you stronger.

examples.text: Si no los matas, ellos te matarán.
examples.en: If you don't kill them, they'll kill you.

examples.text: Quien a hierro mata, a hierro muere.
examples.en: He who lives by the sword shall die by the sword.

examples.text: Si no los matas tú, ellos te matarán.
examples.en: If you don't kill them, they'll kill you.

examples.text: El que a hierro mata a hierro muere.
examples.en: He who lives by the sword will die by the sword.
